picks.editorial_note: A $334 million grant from Schmidt Sciences to NCSA is one of the largest single investments in academic supercomputing infrastructure for AI-driven science this year, dramatically expanding national research computing capacity.
picks.title: NCSA Joins the Schmidt Science Computing Network to Expand Advanced Computing for Scientific Discovery

picks.editorial_note: UKRI's £39 million backing of 20 Turing AI Fellows at Edinburgh represents a major national-scale investment in UK AI research talent and capability across diverse scientific domains.
picks.title: Turing AI Fellows set to strengthen UK’s AI capability | News | The University of Edinburgh

picks.editorial_note: UC Berkeley and Berkeley Lab's new Schmidt-funded AI computing platform at NERSC, part of the same network as NCSA's award, signals a coordinated national push to pair elite universities with national labs on AI infrastructure.
picks.title: UC Berkeley, Berkeley Lab collaboration with Schmidt Science Computing Network will Provide High Performance Computing for Cutting-Edge Research - NERSC: National Energy Research Scientific Computing Center

picks.editorial_note: Fermilab's FemtoMind project applying agentic AI to lattice QCD calculations, under DOE's multi-lab Genesis Mission, shows AI beginning to accelerate fundamental particle physics discovery at national-lab scale.
picks.title: FemtoMind advances Genesis Mission at the proton scale

picks.editorial_note: A systematic review by MIT CSAIL and 17 other institutions cataloging 95 concrete AI catastrophic-risk scenarios is a significant contribution to the policy conversation on AI safety and governance.
picks.title: Researchers find eight ways AI could lead to our downfall

picks.editorial_note: A Cambridge-led analysis finding a third of the global AI supply chain is invisible to governments highlights a major, previously underappreciated gap in AI governance and national security oversight.
picks.title: A third of the global AI supply chain is ‘invisible’ to governments

picks.editorial_note: HKUST and KAUST's new Center for Marine Intelligence and AI4Coral project pairs two major international research institutions to apply AI to global coral reef conservation, a novel real-world application with environmental stakes.
picks.title: HKUST Establishes Center for Marine Intelligence and Partners with KAUST to Launch Inaugural AI4Coral Research Project
picks.university: Hong Kong Univ. of Science and Technology

picks.editorial_note: The acquisition of Imperial College London spinout Cogitat by Indivi for its brain-wave-decoding foundation model demonstrates tangible commercial validation of academic AI neurotechnology research.
picks.title: Imperial spinout Cogitat acquired by Swiss startup Indivi for its brain foundation model

picks.editorial_note: Michigan Tech and UCLA's finding that AI materials-science models need far less training data than assumed could meaningfully lower the cost and barrier to AI-accelerated materials discovery.
picks.title: Less Data, Faster Discovery: Researchers Rethink AI’s Role in Developing New Materials

picks.editorial_note: DARPA's Triage Challenge Finals, testing autonomous systems and human-machine teams in disaster triage scenarios, marks a concrete government milestone in validating AI for life-saving emergency response.
picks.title: DARPA Triage Challenge completes Finals event
